# Psalm 74 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** A-maskil of-Asaph. Why O-God have-you-rejected to-perpetuity? Smokes your-anger against-flock-of your-pasture.

**2** Remember your-congregation you-acquired of-old, you-redeemed tribe-of your-inheritance, mount Zion this you-dwelt in-it.

**3** Lift-up your-steps to-ruins-of perpetuity; all the-evil the-enemy-has-done in-the-sanctuary.

**4** Have-roared your-adversaries in-midst-of your-meeting-place; they-have-set their-signs as-signs.

**5** It-was-known as-one-bringing-up on-high into-thicket-of trees axes.

**6** And-now its-carvings together with-hatchet and-hammers they-smash.

**7** They-have-set on-fire your-sanctuary; to-the-ground they-have-profaned dwelling-place-of your-name.

**8** They-said in-their-heart, 'Let-us-crush-them together'; they-burned all meeting-places-of God in-the-land.

**9** Our-signs not we-see; there-is-no more prophet, and-not with-us who-knows how-long.

**10** How-long O-God will-the-adversary taunt? Will-the-enemy spurn your-name to-perpetuity?

**11** Why do-you-draw-back your-hand, and-your-right-hand? From-midst-of your-bosom consume!

**12** And-God my-king from-of-old, worker-of salvations in-midst-of the-earth.

**13** You divided by-your-strength the-sea; you-broke the-heads-of the-sea-monsters on the-waters.

**14** You crushed the-heads-of Leviathan; you-gave-him food to-people, to-desert-dwellers.

**15** You split-open spring and-torrent; you dried-up rivers ever-flowing.

**16** To-you the-day, also to-you the-night; you established light and-sun.

**17** You set-up all the-boundaries-of the-earth; summer and-winter you formed-them.

**18** Remember this: the-enemy has-taunted YHWH, and-a-foolish people have-spurned your-name.

**19** Do-not give to-the-beast the-life-of your-turtledove; the-life-of your-afflicted-ones do-not forget to-perpetuity.

**20** Look to-the-covenant, for have-been-filled dark-places-of the-land habitations-of violence.

**21** Let-not the-crushed turn-back ashamed; let-the-afflicted and-the-needy praise your-name.

**22** Arise O-God, plead your-cause; remember your-reproach from the-fool all the-day.

**23** Do-not forget the-voice-of your-adversaries; the-uproar-of your-attackers goes-up continually.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **74:5-6**: Obscure Hebrew — the image is of axes destroying ornate Temple woodwork; textual difficulties abound in these verses.

- **74:13-14**: Chaotic-sea mythology applied to YHWH: 'sea-monsters' (tanninim) and 'Leviathan' — creation through combat imagery.

- **74:9**: 'No more prophet' — a cry of despair; divine communication has ceased, unlike in earlier crises.

— EMET
